zh: 新增 working-path-v2 人工工序检查：起链、保留边、锁针桥转角、行端挑针、预留半针、扣眼、接合引拔和接缝均记录明确来源，并检查行号及闭合翻面顺序。
手动页新增人工工序校验阅读入口与 --plan CLI，支持审查说明、逐行操作表、袖窿来源示意及 JSON/Markdown/PDF 导出；输入改变后禁用旧下载，排版失败保留工序。
复杂构造路线明确区分已知教程的人工录入、候选修正与照片生成；未接入自动照片还原，不代表合身、实钩或 G3/G4 通过。
en: Add working-path-v2 manual construction checking with explicit foundations, held edges, bridge corners, row ends, reserved half loops, buttonholes, binding slips and paired seams, including row-number and invisible-join turn-order checks.

Add a manual recipe reader and --plan CLI, review notes, readable row tables, armhole source diagrams and JSON/Markdown/PDF exports; source changes disable stale downloads and PDF failures retain the plan.
Distinguish manually encoded known tutorials and candidate repairs from photo generation. No automatic photo reconstruction, physical fit, execution or G3/G4 qualification is established.
